sam: Heads-up — ArgosHealth private rollout scheduled Thu 2026-04-02 03:00 UTC. Asking for quick go/no-go here. Model: redwood-small-1 (quantized). Pinned version: 2026-04-01-rt1. Canary plan: 5% for 20m -> 25% for 30m -> full. KMS rotation noted in customer schedule around 03:30 UTC (potential collision). Release notes: https://confluence.redwood/argoshealth/release-2026-04-01

deploy-bot: scheduled canary job argos-20260402-canary-1 (slice tenant-argoshealth-a). Canaries will run on dedicated pool dpool-4. Canary config: {"initial_pct":5,"step_pct":25,"step_delay_m":30} 

lina: pinging infra & security about the KMS rotation now. If security wants to move rotation we need confirmation before 01:00 UTC. :eyes:

joan: Security note — KMS rotation in their account will rotate primary key at 03:30 UTC. We prefer no rotation during canary. Options: ask customer to delay rotation OR provide temporary key alias to pin for the rollout. If customer won't delay, recommend postponing for safety.

mike: SRE check — perf baseline for ArgosHealth endpoints: p50 ~110ms, p95 ~420ms. Our rollback triggers are: error rate >1.5% sustained 5m OR p95 increase >2x. We'll run tracing and alerting with these thresholds. Also need feature-flag to force old model if we need instant fallback.

rachel: Ops question — can we reduce initial canary to 3% instead of 5% to lessen blast radius? That buys time if KMS hiccup appears.

sam: fine with 3% start. Update deploy config and re-schedule. Also, pin the model variant to `redwood-small-1@2026-04-01-rt1` (no auto-rolling to patch).

deploy-bot: updated canary config: initial_pct=3, step_pct=20, step_delay_m=30. Canary job argos-20260402-canary-1 queued. Canary will create monitoring group `argos-canary-20260402`.

devops-ci: infra migrations are green on staging; no infra changes required in dpool-4. CI artifact hash: sha256:3a7d... All migration smoke tests passed.

joan: security: we requested Argos to postpone KMS rotation to 04-02 05:00 UTC. They responded: "we can shift to 05:00 if Redwood confirms no further key ops needed before then."

mike: good — with rotation moved, the plan looks OK from SRE. We'll have on-call @mike and @lina during rollout window. Rollback playbook is staged and verified.

rachel: quick checklist: 1) Release notes link posted 2) Canary config set (3% -> 20%) 3) Model pinned 4) Security ok on KMS timing 5) SRE on-call 6) Ops ack. All green from my side.

sam: final ask — please react with :thumbsup: to indicate explicit approval. If anyone sees red flags say HOLD.

lina: :thumbsup:

joan: :thumbsup: (security)

mike: :thumbsup: (sre)

devops-ci: :thumbsup:

rachel: :thumbsup:

sam: GO scheduled for 2026-04-02 03:00 UTC (but KMS rotation moved to 05:00 so no collision). Deploybot will post status updates in-thread. If any metric breaches, we'll run rollback command below.

deploy-bot: rollback command available:```/deploy rollback --canary-id argos-20260402-canary-1 --to-tag 2026-03-15-stable```

sam: thanks everyone. I'll post a short release note to the customer and notify success channel after full cutover.
